research_threshold_scope.quantity_oi: Absolute latest comparable current hourly base-asset quantity OI change >=5%.

reliable_mark_abs_change_at_least_10pct.threshold_comparison_arithmetic: Exact rational cross-product of displayed primary marks.

alert_assessment.confirmation_note: A displayed-value candidate is not a reliable alert. Fresh independent repetition must also resolve material public-source inconsistencies.
